verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a public /pricing page listing concrete feature differences between tiers (e.g., file import limits, integrations, concurrent meetings, admin features) rather than a sales-gated wall, and Enterprise features explicitly require contacting an account manager (otter-docs-43), implying lower tiers are self-serve. However, none of the evidence shows actual dollar prices or explicitly confirms a free tier with no sales contact required. Missing for 10: explicit price figures per tier, confirmation of a self-serve free-to-paid signup flow, and independent verification that no tier below Enterprise requires sales contact.
